scope.onlyMechanismExcluded: Activation/licence enforcement; no licence system copied or bypassed

statusDefinitions.portable-implemented: Actual current source consumer and named portable behavioral coverage exist; no target-hardware success is asserted.
statusDefinitions.partial: A real path exists but one or more stated baseline acceptance or integration requirements remain open.
statusDefinitions.unverified: Evidence does not establish current end-to-end acceptance, especially final native/hardware behavior.
statusDefinitions.excluded: Only the activation/licence mechanism is excluded; no functional baseline row is removed.
statusDefinitions.unsupported-reference: The reference capability/producer or reachability was not established. Do not invent data or call this functional completeness.

pendingHandoffs: Target 2.12.4 full-app radio/quad acceptance and broader required physical input/display/transport combinations; arbitrary damaged-module recovery remains unverified.

focusedNativeEvidence.scope: Actual numeric modules only, not the complete application
